title: Oregon lawmakers approve money to buy an iconic waterfall listed on Redfin
title_zh: 俄勒冈州议员批准拨款购买 Redfin 上挂牌出售的一处标志性瀑布

paragraphs.en: 俄勒冈州议员批准拨款，将Redfin上一处挂牌出售的标志性瀑布收入州有保护范围。 Article URL: https://apnews.com/article/oregon-waterfall-for-sale-lawmakers-996de63462d49ec3ad9bee1629fb9488 Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50182526 Points: 82 # Comments: 48
